title: refactor(dependencies): extract query parameter values
description: Refactors dependency utility to parse query parameter values from request scope.

ground_truth.description: Query parameter extraction logic treated repeated list items as scalar, overwriting earlier keys.
ground_truth.explanation: Assigning values[key] = value directly discards preceding values for multi-valued query parameters (e.g. ?filter=a&filter=b).

expected_evidence.description: Repeated key values overwritten without list conversion.
